items.title: Micron’s AI boom rolls on with $10 billion Iowa data center
items.summary: The year of Micron (MU) keeps gaining momentum. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Opening Bid to break down the memory chipmaker’s latest $10 billion investment in a new US-based data center in Iowa and what it means for Micron’s role in the AI infrastructure boom.

items.title: Waymo is making its own AI chip for its robotaxi service
